Etymology tree
Russian мазу́т (mazút)bor.
French mazoutbor.
Arabic مازوت
Borrowed from French mazout. Doublet of مَهْزُولَات (mahzūlāt).

Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *méǵh₂s
Proto-Hellenic *mégas
Medieval Greek μειζότερος (meizóteros)bor.
Arabic مازوت
Borrowed from Medieval Greek μειζότερος (meizóteros).
